name: Black Tarantula

abilityDetails.Cunning: Increases Critial Rating and Critical Damage Rating by the given potency.
abilityDetails.Combo Shield: While active, the Combo Meter is not reset when struck.
abilityDetails.Evade: Avoid incoming attacks by the given chance.
abilityDetails.Fury: Increases Attack Rating by the given potency.
abilityDetails.Passive Stun: Passively prevent a champion from moving, attacking or defending, leaving them vulnerable to an attack.
abilityDetails.Purify: Removes a given number of Debuffs from the Champion.
abilityDetails.Vulnerability: Reduces Physical Resistance and Energy Resistance by the given potency.
abilityDetails.Halt: Unstoppable Champions react to hits as though they weren't.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Orta olmayan vuruşlara %5 kaçış şansı var (orta vuruşlar hiç kaçılmaz — en güvenli yöntem) ve özel saldırı sonrası 2sn kaçış aktive eder (o sürede orta dışı vuruşla karşılık verme); kaçışında 2sn pasif sersemletir. Kaçışı isabetli saldırı, üçüncül odak, onda-i-soğuk, yetenek azaltma (Mutant) veya tuzak ile yok sayılabilir. Her 5sn pasif iyileşir, iyileşme azaltma/tersine çevirmeye immün — sadece iyileşme engeli işe yarar. Bloklanan E2'si her ışından enerji patlaması verir (tam kaçmıyorsan zorlama); bloktan da kritik vurabilir. Hasarsız debuff'ları %80 şansla purify eder (siper kaynaklı sersemletmede sadece %40).
signatureAbility:
Our Name Means Death
When Black Tarantula Evades, gain +[2 - 12] Combo.
When Evading, inflict a Halt Passive for [2 - 8] seconds. Critical Hits pause this Passive for 1 seconds.
immunityDetails:
• Zehir Bağışıklığı 🧪
• Silme (Nullify) Bağışıklığı (ile sinerji: White Tiger) 🔮
• İyileşme Tersine Çevirmeye dirençli 💚🔄❌

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Black Tarantula is Immune to Poison.
The Black Tarantula's unerring resolve allows him to land Critical Hits into Block and disables the Opponent's Inequity Mastery.
The base duration of personal Stun and Regeneration effects is reduced by 25% for each Prowess effect on the Opponent.

abilitySections.title: Cunning Adversary
content: When his Combo Meter reaches a multiple of 20, gain an indefinite +24% Cunning Passive. Max stacks: 30.
When inflicted with one or more non-Damaging Debuffs, gain +3 Combo. As a Defender, this is doubled and he starts each fight with an indefinite Combo Shield Passive.

abilitySections.title: Underworld Evasion
content: Black Tarantula has a 5% chance to Evade all non-Medium attacks. As a Defender fighting non-Science Attackers, this ability is not active for the first 15 seconds of the fight. His Evades' Ability Accuracy cannot be modified by non-Mutant Champions.
When Evading a hit, gain a +[1,935.8] Fury Passive for 20 seconds, paused during personal Special Attacks. Max stacks: 2.
When Evading Basic Attacks, Black Tarantula inflicts a Stun Passive for 2 seconds, unaffected by Ability Accuracy. While this Stun is active, the Opponent cannot be Untouchable.

abilitySections.title: Face First Into Danger - Special Evade
content: Black Tarantula has a 100% chance to Evade when he would be struck by a Special Attack while Dashing forward or Dodging back.
As an Attacker, this Evade then goes on cooldown for 20 seconds or until Black Tarantula performs 6 Medium Attacks.
If his Dexterity Mastery is prevented when he would Evade a Special Attack, he Evades the rest of it, ignoring the cooldown.
As a Defender, Evade the first incoming non-Medium attack for 2 seconds after the final hit of his Special Attacks.

abilitySections.title: Storied Resilience
content: Black Tarantula does not benefit from Willpower. Instead, he gains a Regeneration Passive every 5 seconds, recovering [1,519.36] Health plus 50% of his stored Adrenaline over 5 seconds.
Legends tell of the Black Tarantula's unique longevity. All modifications to his Regeneration Rate have their potencies reversed, to a maximum gain of 400%.

When inflicted with a non-Damaging Debuff other than Spectre or Petrify, Black Tarantula has a 80% chance to Purify it and gain a 25% Spectre Debuff for 30 seconds. Max stacks: 6. Purify chance is halved for the Parry Mastery's Stun Debuffs.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attack
content: The first hit refreshes personal Spectre Debuffs.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On activation, gain a personal Spectre Debuff.
The final hit grants 2 personal Cunning Passives unless it is Well-Timed Blocked.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Black Tarantula starts each fight with this Special Attack on cooldown for 60 seconds. This cooldown's duration is reduced by 5 seconds when a personal Cunning Passive is gained.
On activation, inflict an indefinite [1,178.57] Vulnerability Passive. Max stacks: 4.

Each beam hit deals a burst of [14,518.5] Energy Damage. On a Critical Hit, the burst benefits from Black Tarantula's Critical Damage multiplier and can trigger through Block. As a Defender, this burst has 85% reduced base potency.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Black Tarantula can only use this attack 2 times per fight.
Reduce the max duration of the Special 2 cooldown by 7.5 seconds and increase the stack limit of personal Vulnerabilities by +1.
Inflict a personal Vulnerability and gain 2 personal Cunning.

Deal a burst of [14,518.5] Energy Damage. This has a chance equal to Black Tarantula's Critical Hit chance to benefit from his Critical Damage multiplier. As a Defender, this burst has 85% reduced base potency.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Our Name Means Death
content: When Black Tarantula Evades, gain +[2 - 12] Combo.
When Evading, inflict a Halt Passive for [2 - 8] seconds. Critical Hits pause this Passive for 1 seconds.
